about:
Shawhan Sheet Metal, LLC, based in Independence, Missouri, has been fabricating and installing sheet metal products in the Kansas City area since 2004. The woman-owned company is led by CEO Mary Shawhan and draws on over 70 years of combined staff experience across architectural sheet metal projects.

The firm provides full-service architectural envelope solutions, from design coordination and estimating through shop drawing, laser scanning, 3D modeling, and custom in-house fabrication. Its shop produces standing seam metal roofs, composite panel (ACM) systems, custom copper gutters, and commercial gutter systems, with capabilities including MIG/TIG welding, punching, cutting, routing, drilling, tapping, and threading. Installation crews hold OSHA 10- and 30-hour certifications.

Shawhan serves retail, commercial, and corporate identity clients, working with architects, owners, and general contractors on new construction and historic restoration projects. Notable projects include General MacArthur Elementary, the Artistry development, Surgicenter, Mazda, Well Sky, and the T-Mobile Center.

The company differentiates itself through technology integration—its in-house laser scanner captures as-built conditions to generate fabrication drawings, reducing lead times—and by offering a single-source provider model that spans design, fabrication, and installation.
